label: HEY1::NCOA2

sections.text: HEY1 encodes a transcriptional repressor downstream of Notch signaling.
NCOA2 encodes a nuclear-receptor transcriptional coactivator.

The fusion joins HEY1 DNA-binding/repressor-associated sequences to NCOA2 transcriptional activation regions, creating a disease-associated transcriptional regulator. It is a recurrent defining alteration in mesenchymal chondrosarcoma.
